messages:
maria: Heads up — we're sizing Dedicated pools for the new quantized 65B (q4f16) bring-up across EU and APAC. Need GPU counts, concurrency per-GPU, and autoscale headroom. Rough bench below.
sasha: Quick bench summary (batch=1, seq=2048, local sim): EU H100 — p50 18ms p95 58ms p99 98ms throughput/gpu ~120 tok/s; EU A100 — p50 28ms p95 85ms p99 150ms throughput/gpu ~95 tok/s; APAC H100 p99 ~110ms (network jitter).
jon: From these numbers I'd target concurrency=6 on H100, concurrency=4 on A100 to keep p99 < 120ms steady-state.
kai: For autoscale headroom: recommend 30% steady headroom + 2 warm burst slots per AZ. Microbursts still hit tail so we need buffer.
nana: (typo fix) ana: Note on quant kernels: q4f16 runs fast int8 path on newer drivers; when fallback to f16 kernels we see 2x tail latency spikes. Need kernel compatibility matrix in rollout.
sasha: Also observed cold-start/warmup effect: first requests after slab spin-up have ~2x p99 for ~45-90s until KV cache and kernels JIT hot. Warmup preloading reduces that.
maria: Proposed initial pool sizes: EU: 12 H100 (concurrency 6) -> supports ~1440 tok/s; APAC: 8 H100 + 6 A100 mix (H100 for hot routes, A100 for low-cost background) with conservative concurrency and extra burst slots. Canary at 15% traffic.
jon: +1. For Dedicated commits we should show unit economics: per-gpu throughput * token cost. If we undercommit we hit autoscale churn.
kai: Autoscaler snippet for warmup + headroom (simple):
```
policy:
  min_replicas: 8
  max_replicas: 40
  target_utilization: 0.70
  warmup_preload: true # triggers kv prefill and kernel preload
  steady_headroom: 0.30
  burst_slots: 2
```
jon: We'll need rollout tests: 1) kernel compatibility sweep (drivers x cudnn x kernel impl), 2) cold-start burn-in (10k requests across AZs), 3) quality regression check vs f16 baseline (small eval set).
nana: (again) ana: For kernel compatibility add metric tag "kernel_path" in traces so we can filter p99 by path.
sasha: Ops note — pack vs pin tradeoff: packing more concurrent contexts per GPU raises throughput but increases p99 tail under microbursts. Keep some pinned slabs for critical customers.
maria: Action items: @sasha run interregion tail bench and produce CSV, @jon draft autoscale rollout playbook, @kai add warmup flag to scaler, @ana produce kernel compatibility matrix. Canary start Thurs 09:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: autoscaler-policy/3472 applied by kai — success :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks — will sync in tomorrow's capacity sync. Keep thread for updates and CSVs.
